title: When the Promise Breaks
author: Vesper Pemberton
blurb: Cyrus Dunmore, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
